1.1.0
https://github.com/google/brotli/releases/tag/v1.1.0

Copy the c/dec, c/enc, c/common, and c/include folders into the root and remove all other files.

Apply https://github.com/google/brotli/commit/85d88cbfc2b742e0742286ec277b73bdbf7be433.patch

GrindCore (audit/native-fixes): brotli_v1_1_0.cmake defines BROTLI_ENCODER_CLEANUP_ON_OOM, and enc/encode.c adds
the out-of-memory checks that mode lacked (each marked [audit fix, audit/other-codecs.md 4.3.1]).

GrindCore (audit/native-fixes): the decoder fix for CVE-2026-111497 (an out-of-bounds write) from upstream v1.1.1,
applied as upstream's own v1.1.0...v1.1.1 diff of dec/decode.c and include/brotli/decode.h. dec/decode.c is now
v1.1.1's plus the patch above; include/brotli/decode.h is v1.1.1's (error code -17,
BROTLI_DECODER_ERROR_FORMAT_BLOCK_SWITCH). common/version.h still says 1.1.0, and the encoder is 1.1.0's
(audit/other-codecs.md 4.3.1 finding 5).
